headline: Steady growth · rising costs pressure FFO · guidance raised
summary_short: CubeSmart posted Q2 2026 diluted EPS of $0.39 (+8.3% y/y) on revenue of $286.5M (+1.5% y/y), while FFO, as adjusted per share fell to $0.63 (-3.1% y/y) as same-store NOI declined 0.7% on operating expenses outpacing revenue.
summary_long: Revenue rose 1.5% y/y to $286.5M on higher same-store rental rates, with period-end occupancy flat at 91.0%. Same-store operating expenses grew 4.4% y/y, outpacing 0.8% same-store revenue growth and pushing same-store NOI down 0.7%; FFO, as adjusted per share fell 3.1% to $0.63. Net income and diluted EPS still rose (+8.3% to $0.39), helped by $10.6M lower depreciation y/y and a $2.5M gain on a land-parcel sale, partly offset by higher G&A and interest expense. The company amended its revolver to $1B (from $850M) extending maturity to June 2030, and repurchased $42.5M of stock. Full-year 2026 guidance was raised: diluted EPS to $1.58-$1.64 and FFO, as adjusted to $2.54-$2.60.

drivers.explanation: Increase attributed to higher rental rates across the same-store portfolio.
Same-store operating expenses grew 4.4% y/y (led by personnel and property taxes), outpacing 0.8% same-store revenue growth.
Net income gain reflects $10.6M lower y/y depreciation and amortization plus a $2.5M gain on a land-parcel sale, partly offset by higher G&A and interest expense.
CEO cited accelerating same-store revenue growth from improving occupancy and pricing trends, plus a new Heitman joint venture funding buybacks while preserving investment flexibility.
